entry.title: Charter Oak Maduro Rothschild — Single
experienceTags: Pairings: Espresso, cocoa, cola or dark rum
Occasion: Compact Broadleaf smoke, casual evening
entry.summaryHtml: Dark chocolate, espresso, molasses, cedar, earth and black pepper make the Charter Oak Maduro a compact Broadleaf smoke with very little fuss. A Nicaraguan Habano binder and Nicaraguan filler add woody spice and leather beneath the wrapper's natural sweetness, and the 4.5″ × 50 Rothschild keeps the profile dense without turning into a long session.
entry.noteHtml: Cigar Hut lists the Charter Oak Maduro Rothschild single at A$34.
